name: Hard-Loc-Bench_v0
description: Hard-Loc-Bench_v0 is a benchmark of challenging object localization examples designed to evaluate models' robustness to difficult real-world conditions such as heavy occlusion, scale and viewpoint variation, and cluttered backgrounds. It provides curated hard cases and precise localization annotations to stress-test detection/localization methods and measure failure modes under realistic perturbations.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face-hosted benchmark used by researchers focused on localization robustness; not a broadly established community standard.
